svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: Core row of generation 1 and generation 2 from the saved RNDW state
svg.title: Core row of generation 1 and generation 2 from the saved RNDW state
svg.text: The core row of the CPU: one square per node slot, from the saved RNDW world (tick 110 M)
generation 1 = textbook seed; generation 2 = built by generation 1. Empty slots in generation 2 are the gates the improver removed.
whole core row: 2238 nodes (the 256 RAM tiles are a separate block)
zoom: four full adders (alu.fa0 .. fa3), 25 slots each in gen 1
zoom: first 80 nodes of the ALU (muxes: 8 slots each in gen 1, 4 used in gen 2)
